verdict.rationale: The Identity docs include copy-pasteable runnable code samples, such as a curl call creating a verification session against the live API endpoint, and they document the VerificationSession API. However, nothing in the evidence shows an interactive API explorer, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec at the standard paths. Missing for 10: an interactive or try-it API reference, in-browser execution of examples, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.
